source_rule.function_source:
def _set_body_inertias(self):
        """Note: this is to account for the asset_options.armature parameter in IGE."""
        inertias = self._robot.root_physx_view.get_inertias()
        offset = torch.zeros_like(inertias)
        offset[:, :, [0, 4, 8]] += 0.01
        new_inertias = inertias + offset
        self._robot.root_physx_view.set_inertias(new_inertias, torch.arange(self.num_envs))
source_rule.basis_invariance: 0.01I is isotropic, so adding0.01 to principal moments is equivalent in any rotated inertia basis.
source_rule.body_scope: all bodies returned by root_physx_view.get_inertias; actual returned/merged PhysX body set not measured

assumptions: Arm7 principal mass block uses the same 9-coordinate Panda state; free peg dynamics are not included in the arm block.
Effective inertia1/diag(M^-1) lets other arm coordinates accelerate and locks finger coordinates; it is not the diagonal of M.
No contact/constraint/velocity-bias/gravity integration is used in fixed-torque incremental acceleration.
Body isotropic inertia offsets leave geometric Jacobians unchanged and create dense generalized mass increments; joint armature creates a diagonal generalized mass increment.
